description: Reword a Standing Instruction when the Developer changes a rule, make it a hard rule (hard: true) or an ordinary one again (hard: false), set or change the helper limit it holds (helpers_at_once), or remove it with an empty text when they drop it. Give any of text, hard and helpers_at_once; what you leave out stays. The IDs (s1, s2...) are in get_status.

hard.description: true for a rule that must never be broken (not just a preference); get_status, the session start and get_rules list those first as HARD RULE.

helpers_at_once.description: Makes this rule the project's helper limit: the most Tasks that may be 'with a helper' at once, such as 2 when the Developer says 'at most 2 helpers in parallel'. One rule holds the limit; setting it here takes it off any other. 0 removes it.

id.description: The Standing Instruction ID, such as 's2'.

text.description: The new wording; empty to remove the rule. Left out, the wording stays.

name: update_standing_instruction
title: Update Standing Instruction
